task.title: Trace a CIS value to its source
task.shortdesc: Trace one configured value back to the starter preset, CIS layer, merge decision, and later edits before export.

prereq.p: Open a profile that was created from a starter preset or has a CIS Level 1 or Level 2 layer applied.

context.p: Tracing a value is useful when a reviewer asks whether a setting came from the original baseline, the CIS layer, an import, a manual edit, or raw fallback.

step.cmd: Open All settings and filter by configured values or by the CIS source badge.

info.p: Expected result: the relevant policy or managed preference remains visible with its source attribution.

step.cmd: Read the source attribution and identify whether the current value is baseline, CIS, manual, imported, or raw.

info.p: Expected result: you can name the immediate source of the value.

step.cmd: Open the related CIS recommendation or Firefox policy topic when a generated layer contributed the value.

info.p: Expected result: you can see the recommendation ID, path, value, channel support, and merge rule.

step.cmd: Check the merge decision: added_from_cis, already_satisfied, cis_replaced_base, kept_base_only, kept_base_stricter, or manual_review_kept_base.

info.p: Expected result: you know whether CIS added the value, confirmed it, replaced it, or left a base value for review.

step.cmd: Resolve manual-review or conflict states before saving.

info.note: Do not hide a manual_review_kept_base decision by making an unrelated manual edit; record the review reason first.

step.cmd: Validate and export only after the source and decision are understandable to another reviewer.

info.p: Expected result: the exported policies.json reflects a reviewed choice, while BPM-only attribution remains in the profile.

result.p: The configured value can be explained as baseline, CIS, manual, imported, or raw, with a visible merge decision and review status.

postreq.p: If attribution is ambiguous, compare the profile against a blank profile plus the same CIS layer, then inspect imports and manual changes.
